title: Generics & Traits
objectives: Write generic functions with trait bounds
Choose impl Trait vs generics vs dyn Trait

examples.name: traits.rs

exercise.prompt: Implement trait `Describe` with method `describe(&self) -> String`; implement it for `Dog` and `Robot`, then write one generic fn that prints both via a Vec<&dyn Describe>.
hints: Each impl returns a distinct String.

options: mixing many types behind one trait
